study type: Feasibility and reliability assessment (Prospective observational study)
outcome: Correlation between NICOM-CO and echocardiography-derived CO
cohort: Twenty term infants with neonatal encephalopathy (NE) undergoing therapeutic hypothermia (TH).
finding: Noninvasive hemodynamic assessment of infants with NE during therapeutic hypothermia and rewarming is feasible and reveals potentially important changes in CO, SVR, and SctO2.
followup_time: Measurements taken during therapeutic hypothermia and rewarming, with observations of SctO2 and SVR changes over the first 30 hours of TH.
